explanation: Existing goodwill is considered an accumulated profit/loss of the old partnership and is therefore written off by debiting the old partners' capital accounts in their old profit-sharing ratio.

card.back: Goodwill appearing in the books will be written-off by debiting old partners' capital accounts in their old profit sharing ratio.
